author: ScoodleN
body:
Two years ago, I was falsely banned. I, however, did not make an appeal at the time due to an overwhelming amount of salt. I was banned for "anti-knockback and fly" http://prntscr.com/bumt95 . I was banned on nebula/capture the monument after a mod "caught me hacking". What had happened was that I build over from the sky and jumped right over the spawn of the opposing team. When I jumped over to the spawn a glitch of some sort must've occurred that didn't allow me to fall or move. I was being shot at when the mod PeachyYas saw that I wasn't being knocked back as I was being held in the air. I can't blame him/her for banning me, but it was a false ban. Nebula on avicus was honestly one of my favorite games to play, and I'd like to be able to play again. 

Thank you for taking the time to read my appeal :D
~Scoodle
